subject: Life Skills
title: What Laundry Symbols Mean
description: A fast breakdown of What Laundry Symbols Mean for builders.

hook.text: There are over 30 standard laundry symbols on clothing labels. Most people can't read a single one.

buildup.text: A triangle means bleach. A circle means dry clean. A square means drying method.

discovery.text: The washtub symbol sets the temperature. More dots inside mean hotter water is acceptable.

twist.text: An X through any symbol means never do that action. A crossed-out iron means no ironing at all.

climax.text: Learn just five base shapes: tub, triangle, circle, square, and iron. Then read dots and lines.

punchline.text: Five shapes unlock every label in your closet.

quiz.question: What does a triangle symbol on a laundry label mean?
